shiro.name: Shiro
shiro.blurb: A plain little call duck. Perfect as it is.
shiro.look: no outfit at all: just the plain white duck

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.blurb: Ready for the open sea, or at least the pond.
sailor.look: a small navy sailor collar with white stripes and a red bow, and a tiny white sailor cap

neko.name: Neko
neko.blurb: A cat-ear hoodie. Duck or cat? Yes.
neko.look: a soft gray cat-ear hoodie with the hood up around its face

super.name: Super
super.blurb: Golden hair, orange gi, power level rising.
super.look: spiky golden hair standing straight up like flames, and an orange martial-arts top with a dark-blue belt

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.look: a charcoal ninja hood with a long red headband tied at the back

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.blurb: A fox mask from the shrine festival.
kitsune.look: a white fox mask with red markings worn tilted on the side of its head, small orange fox ears, and a red scarf

yukata.name: Matsuri
yukata.blurb: Dressed up for the summer festival.
yukata.look: an indigo summer yukata with a simple white wave pattern, a red obi sash, and a pink flower on its head

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.blurb: A tiny warrior in a very big helmet.
samurai.look: a little red samurai helmet with a golden crescent crest, and a dark-blue jacket

king.name: King
king.blurb: Rules the pond. Earned every minute.
king.look: a small golden crown and a red cape with a white fur collar

astro.name: Astro
astro.blurb: Studied so much it reached space.
astro.look: a white space suit and a round clear glass helmet bubble around its head

shizuku.name: Shizuku
shizuku.blurb: A school idol. Every session is a stage.
shizuku.look: Shizuku Osaka from Love Live! Nijigasaki: long straight dark-brown hair with neat bangs flowing down behind its back, tied in a half-up ponytail with her big red ribbon bow at the back of the head, and a light-blue idol outfit with white frills

nurse.name: Nurse
nurse.blurb: Takes care of everyone, starting with your focus.
nurse.look: a small white nurse cap with a red cross, a pale pink nurse collar, and a stethoscope around its neck

senku.name: Senku
senku.look: Senku from Dr. Stone: tall spiky upswept white hair with pale green tips, the thin stone-crack marks on one side of his face, a simple light-green caveman tunic, and a small glass flask of bubbling green liquid

naruto.name: Naruto
naruto.blurb: Never gives up on a session.
naruto.look: Naruto: spiky bright-yellow hair, a blue Leaf Village headband with a metal plate, three whisker marks on each cheek, and an orange-and-black jacket

loid.name: Loid
loid.blurb: A spy on a mission: study hard and blend in.
loid.look: Loid Forger from Spy x Family: short neat blond hair swept to the side, a dark-green suit jacket over a black vest, a white shirt and a red tie

yor.name: Yor
yor.look: Yor Forger as the Thorn Princess from Spy x Family: long straight black hair with bangs and two long locks in front, a golden rose headband, a black off-the-shoulder dress with red roses, and a small gold stiletto

anya.name: Anya
anya.look: Anya Forger from Spy x Family: shoulder-length pink hair with her two little black cone-shaped hair ornaments on top, and her black Eden Academy school dress with gold trim

kirby.name: Kirby
kirby.blurb: Inhales whole chapters in one go.
kirby.look: Kirby: a cute round pink Kirby kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with Kirby's face on top of the hood (two tall dark-blue oval eyes with a white shine, pink blush and a tiny smile), and a small star scarf

vegeta.name: Vegeta
vegeta.blurb: A Saiyan prince never skips a study day.
vegeta.look: Vegeta from Dragon Ball Z: tall black spiky flame-shaped hair with a sharp widow's peak, a blue bodysuit with white Saiyan armour and yellow shoulder pads

clive.name: Clive
clive.blurb: A Dominant of fire, with a study plan.
clive.look: Clive Rosfield from Final Fantasy XVI: short dark-brown hair, a short dark beard, a plain dark cape over his shoulders (no fur) on his dark leather outfit, and a big sword hilt over his shoulder

sonic.name: Sonic
sonic.look: Sonic the Hedgehog: a blue Sonic hood with his big swept-back blue quills and little blue ears framing the duck's face, and a small gold ring floating beside it

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.blurb: Ex-SOLDIER. Carries a sword as big as the syllabus.
cloud.look: Cloud Strife from Final Fantasy VII: tall spiky blond hair, a dark navy sleeveless SOLDIER top with a silver shoulder pauldron, and his huge Buster Sword strapped upright on his back

sora.name: Sora
sora.blurb: Unlocks every chapter with a Keyblade.
sora.look: Sora from Kingdom Hearts 2: big spiky brown hair, an all-black short-sleeved hooded jacket with white lining and silver patches on the shoulders, a navy undershirt with a red patch in the middle, his silver crown pendant necklace, and the Kingdom Key Keyblade resting upright behind him

venus.name: Venus
venus.blurb: A guardian of love and good study habits.
venus.look: Sailor Venus: long golden-blonde hair with a big red bow, a gold tiara with an orange gem, an orange choker, and her white sailor uniform with an orange collar and a blue front bow

yu.name: Yu
yu.look: Yu Narukami from Persona 4 Revival: neat straight silver-gray hair with a bob and bangs (only medium-gray lines inside the hair, never black), and the black Yasogami High school jacket with a high collar, worn open over a white shirt

makoto.name: Makoto
makoto.look: Makoto Yuki from Persona 3 Reload: dark blue hair with long bangs swept over one side of the face (the duck's own eye stays visible), the black Gekkoukan High blazer with a white shirt and red ribbon, a red S.E.E.S. armband, small gray clip-on earphones resting at his collar (not on the ear) with a black cable down to a small gray cylindrical MP3 player hanging on his chest

joker.name: Joker
joker.look: Joker from Persona 5: messy black curly hair, his white domino mask (the duck's eye shows through it), and his black Phantom Thief long coat with a high collar

kiryu.name: Kiryu
kiryu.blurb: The Dragon of Dojima never skips a session.
kiryu.look: Kazuma Kiryu from Yakuza: short slicked-back dark hair, a light gray suit over an open-collared dark red shirt

link.name: Link
link.blurb: Hero of Twilight. Every session is another dungeon cleared.
link.look: Link from The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess: his long floppy olive-green cap with the tip hanging down behind the head, light golden-brown hair with long side bangs, an olive-green tunic with a brown leather belt over a light chainmail collar, and on his back the Hylian Shield (blue with a silver rim, a silver Triforce and the red bird crest) with the Master Sword's blue-violet hilt sticking up over the shoulder

zelda.name: Zelda
zelda.blurb: Princess of Hyrule. Wisdom, one session at a time.
zelda.look: Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess: long straight brown hair with bangs and two long front locks wrapped in white bands, a gold tiara with a blue gem on the forehead, ornate gold shoulder pieces, and a white royal gown with lilac panels and a tabard down the front showing a gold Triforce above a red crest

miku.name: Miku
miku.blurb: Hums along to every session. The first sound of a focused future.
miku.look: Hatsune Miku: very long turquoise twin tails tied high on the head with black-and-red hair ties, turquoise bangs, a black headset with turquoise lights and a small microphone, and her gray sleeveless top's collar with a turquoise necktie

bocchi.name: Bocchi
bocchi.blurb: Practices for hours and talks to no one. The perfect study buddy.
bocchi.look: Hitori 'Bocchi' Gotoh from Bocchi the Rock!: long straight pink hair with bangs down to just above the eye, her two little square hair clips on top of the head, one blue and one yellow, a pink tracksuit jacket zipped up to the collar, and a black electric guitar on her back

monika.name: Monika
monika.look: Monika from Doki Doki Literature Club!: long coral-brown hair in a high ponytail tied with a big white bow at the back, neat bangs with two long strands framing the face, and her school uniform: a warm gray blazer over a white shirt with a red ribbon at the collar

trunks.name: Trunks
trunks.blurb: Came back from the future to make sure you study.
trunks.look: Future Trunks from Dragon Ball Z: straight lavender hair down to the chin with a middle part, a steel-blue jacket with a small Capsule Corp logo patch on the shoulder over a black shirt, and his sword's hilt sticking up over the shoulder from a brown strap across the chest

godzilla.name: Godzilla
godzilla.blurb: King of the Monsters, and of the pond.
godzilla.look: Godzilla: a charcoal gray-green Godzilla kigurumi hood framing the duck's own face and beak, with Godzilla's snout and a row of small white teeth along the top of the hood, and pale jagged dorsal plates running from the hood down the duck's back

snoopy.name: Snoopy
snoopy.look: Snoopy from Peanuts: two long black floppy dog ears hanging down from the top of the head on both sides, a red collar, and a tiny yellow Woodstock bird sitting on top of its head

ike.name: Ike
ike.blurb: Leader of the Greil Mercenaries. He fights for his focus!
ike.look: young Ike from Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (his Path of Radiance costume): spiky dark-blue hair, a dark brown headband with long tails trailing behind, a red cape wrapped around his shoulders like a scarf, a brown leather guard on his shoulder, a navy-blue tunic with a high collar, and his sword Ragnell strapped upright on his back: a broad golden-yellow blade with a dark gray crossguard and grip

witch.name: Witch
witch.blurb: Out trick-or-treating. The bucket is mostly flashcards.
witch.look: a Halloween witch: a tall floppy black pointed witch hat with a purple band and a small buckle, a short black cape with a purple lining, and a little orange jack-o'-lantern treat bucket resting against its wing

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.blurb: Thankful for every hour on the clock.
harvest.look: a cozy Thanksgiving harvest look: a knitted mustard-yellow scarf, a little brown pilgrim hat with a gold buckle, and a small round pumpkin pie resting against its wing

santa.name: Santa
santa.blurb: Making a list of chapters, checking it twice.
santa.look: Santa Claus: a red Santa hat with white fur trim and a white pompom, a red coat with white fur trim and a black belt with a gold buckle, and a small brown sack of presents on its back
